title: Enterprise Data Controls intake & prioritization playbook
creator: Sofia Morales
description:
Problem: Enterprise accounts repeatedly request granular data governance controls (logging redaction, configurable retention, PII tag handling, and audit exports) but we lack a repeatable intake and prioritization process that aligns product, security, and sales. Current ad-hoc triage leads to mis-scoped work, delayed SLAs, and unmet compliance needs.

Goal: Build a lightweight intake + scoring playbook and a pro forma requirements template for non-bug enterprise requests related to data governance. The playbook should: (1) capture essential customer context, (2) provide a reproducible prioritization rubric, (3) define minimum security/legal checkpoints, and (4) output a recommended route (hosted roadmap, Dedicated quick-fix, Private deployment, or 3rd-party integration).

Scope: Initial focus on four candidate features: logging redaction rules, configurable retention windows (per-customer & per-route), PII detection & obfuscation pipelines, and audit export formats (CSV/JSON long-term export + SIEM hooks). Excludes: full e-discovery workflows, multi-tenant cross-customer data joins, and new encryption-at-rest primitives beyond KMS integrations already planned.

Outcomes: (1) Intake form prototype used by Solutions and CSMs, (2) prioritization rubric that feeds into weekly PM triage, (3) decision matrix mapping feature to delivery path, (4) clear acceptance criteria and security gating for any effort.

Notes on enterprise constraints: Many prospects cite HIPAA and GDPR retention/erasure obligations; some large customers require audit exports to feed their SIEM with per-token attribution. Sales has flagged three Proof-of-Concepts with high contract velocity if these controls ship in Q2.
acceptance_criteria: Intake form live in Confluence and triage workflow documented in Playbook (link included)
Scoring rubric defined and used in 3 pilot triages with cross-functional sign-off
Decision matrix mapping each of the four candidate features to a recommended delivery path
Security/legal checklist incorporated; at least one security sign-off flow validated
One pilot customer intake progressed to scoped backlog item with estimate and release lane assigned
